mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.2% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% in a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 720) and retail sales (RSAFS < 400000) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 720 and RSAFS < 400000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates an economic contraction phase that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals rising inflation that may prompt central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL y/y inflation > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS > 133000) and unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicate labor market confusion that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 133000 and UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 750 indicate a housing market recovery that boosts construction and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 750.
